checks.title: Tide & Tile — Make a daily harbor route
checks.firstRead:
DAILY HARBOR PUZZLE

Make today’s harbor route

For casual players who want a calm 2–5-minute puzzle break with clear rules.

Try it with sample data
Loads a guided board. It does not change your daily progress.
Free to play
Works offline after the first visit
Progress stays in this browser’s storage
Four tiles need one turn in the sample.

THREE PRACTICE ROUTES

Archive boards

Practice three routes at any time. They rise from 4 to 25 misplaced tiles.

Play the 4-turn guided route
Dock lesson
Practice 20-turn corners
Breakwater bend
Play the 25-turn scramble
Harbor circuit
How to play Tide & Tile
Turn a tile by tapping it or pressing Enter or Space.
Join every channel into one continuous route.
Finish near the fewest turns to earn a medal.

What it does not do: there are no timers, lives, accounts, or leaderboards. The turn limit gives each route a clear finish.
